us_equity.hypothesis: Short-horizon reversal after unusually large idiosyncratic daily moves, separated from market-explained moves.
blocking_gates: verified point-in-time universe and delisted returns
us_equity.falsification: Within-security date permutation placebo and conservative-cost robustness.

kr_equity.hypothesis: After a market drawdown, enter on subsequent volatility normalization; test whether this differs from buying immediately during the drawdown.
blocking_gates: point-in-time listed/tradable stock and ETF universe
kr_equity.falsification: Reject if data gates fail, net holdout does not meet preregistered matched B&H criteria, or result fails under realistic costs and leakage/survivorship audit.

crypto_mtf.core_estimand: For a frozen signal, proportion reaching the predeclared target before stop within 10T or 20T; report timeouts separately and direction-at-horizon/net PnL over all signals as secondary endpoints.
crypto_mtf.coverage_contract: Eligible data-quality-valid symbol-time opportunities are the denominator; abstains remain in denominator. Report long, short, symbol and timeframe coverage separately.
crypto_mtf.dependence: Synchronized calendar-time block bootstrap across symbols; block rule and minimum effective information fixed before outcomes.
crypto_mtf.decision_rule: Do not claim >=80% unless coverage >=10%, minimum effective sample is met, and dependence-adjusted lower confidence bound is >=80%.
crypto_mtf.blocking_gate: Resolve R005 spacing/coverage contradiction in a new version before labels or tuning.
